name: Jakarta
blurb: Jakarta has experienced significant travel disruptions following the eruption of the Mount Anak Krakatau volcano, which sent volcanic ash across the region and prompted airport closures. The activity led to widespread flight suspensions and strandings at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.

quotes.text: Eight Indonesian airports remain shut due to volcanic ash from Anak Krakatau   - https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-jakarta-airports-closed-volcano-eruption-ash-anak-krakatau-6366231

Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau volcano erupted early Sunday, prompting the cancellation of all flights at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and disrupting other domestic airports as volcanic ash drifted across parts of western Indonesia.

Jakarta Soekarno-Hatta (CGK) Airport has been closed since early Sunday, and the closure has been extended several times.

Volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatau is the reason.
